query:
SELECT 
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.role,
  u.createdAt,
  u.lastSignedIn,
  COUNT(c.id) as contact_count
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.parentUserId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%jiang%'
GROUP BY u.id;
